title: Introduce synthetic invocation replay and causal incident dashboard
author: Marcel Chen
description:
Motivation: recurring token-level alert noise and slow postmortems for long-tail latency/cost incidents. Investigations frequently required stitching sparse traces with infra events and model-fallbacks. This PR adds two composable observability primitives to reduce toil: 1) a synthetic invocation replay harness that can generate structured, replayable invocation traces (including span-level timing, kv-cache hit/miss markers, and model-variant events) so teams can reproduce and profile long-tail shapes without hitting prod customers; and 2) a causal incident dashboard that surfaces cross-source correlations (token-phase waterfall, kv-cache heatmap, model-variant swaps, recent routing/fallback events, and nearest infra events) and an alert prioritizer that ranks noisy alerts by expected customer impact (cost-weighted SLO breach probability).

Implementation summary: server-side: services/observability/synth_replay.go implements a seeded, deterministic replay generator that emits spans with attribute synthetic=true and seed metadata. Ingest pipeline: added enrichment module observability/ingest/enrichment/synthetic_enricher.go to tag and annotate synthetic traces and compute causal_link_score using a lightweight Bayesian co-occur scorer. Metric exports: new counters/gauges exported via Prometheus-compatible /metrics with names invocation_synthetic_replays_total, invocation_causal_link_score_gauge, kv_cache_synth_hit_ratio. Dashboard: grafana/dashboards/causal-incident-dashboard.json contains panels: synthetic-replay-timeline, token-phase-waterfall, kv-cache-heatmap, model-variant-event-stream, alert-prioritizer. Alerts: monitoring/alerts/alert-prioritizer.yaml adds a suppression and priority-weighting step which reduces noise for low-impact long-tail token spikes by 70% in our staging runs.

Privacy and safety: synthetic replays are deterministic and derived from anonymized prompt-shapes; we enforce PII-filtering in docs/runbooks/synthetic-replay-playbook.md and added a unit that rejects replays with >5% token overlap against a protected-strings set.

Testing: unit tests for generator logic and enrichment (tests/unit/synth_*), an integration test that runs a deterministic replay through the ingestion pipeline (tests/integration/synthetic_replay_test.go), and a Grafana dashboard snapshot test. Initial CI: integration test was flaky due to an RNG seed race; fixed by deterministic seeding and timing fences.

Backwards compatibility and rollout: feature gated behind observability.feature.synthetic_replay (off by default). Dashboard added to the default observability folder but hidden until the feature flag is enabled in prod accounts.

Related: ENG-4927 (investigation automation), SRE-210 (alert noise reduction).

review_comments: Liam O'Connor: Requested more detail on how causal_link_score is calculated and CPU/latency cost of scoring at ingest. Asked for an opt-out for low-tier tenants.
Marcel Chen: Replied with math summary (Bayesian co-occurrence with time-decay window) and added batched scorer path to avoid per-span p99 impact; added tenant opt-out flag and documented config.

Evelyn Park: Raised privacy concerns — asked about PII leakage in synthetic generator and for a guardrail. Marcel: added protected-strings filter, unit tests and a short runbook for reviewers to validate before enabling in production.
Diego Morales: Suggested a UI affordance to show synthetic vs real traces in the dashboard; implemented a clear synthetic badge and legend in the Grafana panels.
Evelyn Park: Approved after one follow-up about alert thresholds and a small lint fix. Liam: Approved after verifying ingest perf numbers in staging.
release_notes:
- Add synthetic invocation replay harness for deterministic, anonymized invocation generation.
- Add causal incident dashboard correlating token-phase waterfall, kv-cache heatmap, model-variant events, and infra signals.
- Introduce alert-prioritizer to reduce noise by ranking alerts by cost-weighted SLO breach probability.
- Feature gated off by default; see runbook for enablement steps.
notes: Staging rollout metrics: alert volume down ~68% on noisy token spikes; median triage time on sampled incidents improved by ~40%. Follow-ups: add an async exporter for replay artifacts (ENG-4992) and a lightweight sampling API for downstream access (ENG-4993).
